verdict.rationale: Munito AI's docs list 'streaming' as a capability, and it exposes the OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages APIs, so streaming completions is a documented first-party feature. The pack never states that streaming uses SSE or delivers token-by-token deltas, so only the bare capability is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit SSE transport documentation, token-by-token delta format and examples, latency or time-to-first-token details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream completions token by token over SSE for responsive user experiences

citations.quote: Capabilities: structured outputs, tool calls, vision, speech to text, streaming, reasoning and prompt caching.
Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs, plus the Anthropic Messages API.
